resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Accessing Strings[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Strings can be thought of as a sequence of characters. Each character in the string has its unique position (or [b]index[/b]).

You can access a character of a string using its index:[code format="py" codeId="3114"]x = "Hello"
print([b]x[2][/b])[/code]
The code above accesses the 3rd character of the string.
[note]The index starts from 0, meaning that the first character has the index 0.[/note]

resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Accessing Strings[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You can loop through the characters in a string using a [b]for[/b] loop:[code format="py" codeId="3117"]x = "Hello"
for c in x:
    print(c)[/code]
[note]During each iteration, the variable [b]c[/b] will represent the current character of the string.[/note]

resolved.title: 元音字母数量
resolved.problem_statement_md:
编写程序来计算给定文本中元音的数量。
元音包含 **a**、**e**、**i**、**o**和**u**。

输入一个字符串，输出元音字母的数量。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Accessing Strings[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You need to make a program that counts the number of vowels in a given text.
The vowels are [b]a[/b], [b]e[/b], [b]i[/b], [b]o[/b], and [b]u[/b].

Take a string as input and output the number of vowels.

[b]Sample Input:[/b]
this is great

[b]Sample Output: [/b]
4

[note]There are [b]4[/b] vowels in the given text.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 变量字符串，判断每个字符是否为元音字母，并计数统计。
